task: Build the entire demo in the three supplied placeholder files. Create a clean, self-contained Three.js + Vite browser scene with a large flat ground plane and a basic procedural car made only from Three.js primitive geometry (no external models, textures, images, or assets). Make the car clearly read as a car: body, cabin, four wheels, sensible proportions. Make it drivable with WASD and arrow keys using simple arcade-style acceleration, braking/reverse, steering, damping, and wheel rotation; add a smooth third-person chase camera. Add restrained lighting, shadows, sky/background and subtle ground/grid cues so motion and scale are readable while the world remains fundamentally a flat plane. Keep the implementation compact, performant, responsive, and usable on desktop. IMPORTANT MANIFEST CONTRACT: package.json must be syntactically valid strict JSON, with double-quoted property names and string values, no comments, no trailing commas, and no JavaScript syntax. It must define exactly these dependency entries: dependencies.three = "0.185.1" and devDependencies.vite = "8.2.2". scripts.build must be exactly "vite build"; scripts.dev may be exactly "vite"; scripts.preview may be exactly "vite preview"; define no other scripts or dependencies. Before returning your diff, mentally parse package.json as JSON and correct any syntax error. index.html must be the full page entry point. src/main.js must contain the Three.js implementation. Do not add or reference any other project files. CRITICAL PATCH CONTRACT: the response must be a complete canonical git unified diff that passes `git apply --check` against the supplied placeholder files. Do not truncate the diff. Every hunk body line must begin with exactly one valid diff prefix character: space for context, + for additions, - for deletions, or backslash only for the standard no-newline marker. Every @@ hunk header old/new line count must exactly match the number of context/deleted/added lines that follow before the next hunk or file. Because each supplied target file is tiny, prefer one straightforward replacement hunk per file rather than clever or fragmented hunks. Re-check all three hunk headers and line counts before responding. OUTPUT CONTRACT: return only one canonical git-style unified diff modifying exactly package.json, index.html, and src/main.js. No Markdown fences, prose, commentary, renames, new files, or deleted files.
